methodology: Fair head-to-head: FCFS baseline vs FarmShield Fleet Agent on independent SimulationService copies. Identical scenario JSON, tractors, fuel, jobs, deadlines, A* routes, simulator ticks, time horizon, seeded incidents, job progress rules, and Safety Agent validator. Assignments commit only after Navigation + Safety approval. Metrics are computed from each copy's private productivity ledger and counters — never invented or hardcoded.

definitions.jobs_completed: Jobs that reached COMPLETED status within the horizon.
definitions.travel_time: Simulated minutes in TRAVELING status (not counted as productive work).
definitions.idle_time: Simulated minutes operational but neither traveling nor working.
definitions.missed_deadlines: Late completions plus incomplete jobs past deadline at horizon.
definitions.fuel_consumed: Fuel burned during travel and work (chaos fuel edits excluded).
definitions.safety_violations: Safety Agent hard rejections during schedule_and_apply commits.
definitions.breakdown_recovery_success: Seeded/injected breakdown recoveries where the released job was reassigned or no job needed reassignment.
